prompt: A clear editorial-style illustration of an AI agent as a bounded workflow rather than a humanoid: at the center, a glowing language-model core receives a goal card and follows a visible looping path through labeled stations—“plan,” “write code,” “run tool,” “inspect result,” “choose next action”—with arrows returning to earlier steps after failures; around it are constrained tool panels for a terminal, database, web documents and a calculator, each connected by gated cables and framed by instruction rules, available-data limits and a prominent stop boundary. On one side, several smaller agents take different routes toward the same task board and exchange notes; on the other, a human expert reviews a stack of polished-looking outputs, marking one with an error warning to show that plausible results still need checking. Include subtle visual signs of risk—a loop repeating an incorrect step and a compass pointed toward a misleading target—while avoiding any face, body or suggestion that the system has human-like intentions.
